findings.title: Apache 2.4.50 Path Traversal to RCE (CVE-2021-42013) - Flag Captured
findings.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 is vulnerable to CVE-2021-42013, a path traversal and remote code execution vulnerability. The vulnerability allows attackers to bypass path normalization using double URL-encoded sequences (%%32%65 = .e) to traverse directories and execute arbitrary commands via /bin/sh through the cgi-bin alias. The flag was found at /FLAG.txt.
